Perfect! Both `bun test` and `bun run typecheck` pass. The fix is complete.

## Summary

Fixed the pagination bug in `/app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts` line 16. The issue was an off-by-one error: the code was adding 1 to the page number when calling `.paginate()`, but the page parameter is already 1-indexed with a default of 1 from the validator. This caused `/posts` and `/posts?page=1` to be paginated as if they were page 2, skipping the 10 most recent posts entirely. Changing `.paginate({ page: page + 1, perPage: 10 })` to `.paginate({ page, perPage: 10 })` corrects this so page 1 now shows posts 1–10, page 2 shows 11–20, etc.
